rule_extra: Larry and David Ellison are separate checkbooks from each other and from CBS News. Opening CBS does not open these rows; clicking through Paramount Skydance or the family does.

records.amount_label: >$30M outside money since 2021, mostly Tim Scott
records.summary: Larry Ellison's federal file is Super PAC scale on the Republican side: OpenSecrets put him 11th among 2022 megadonors (~$31M outside). The largest recent slice is more than $30M since 2021 into Opportunity Matters Fund (Tim Scott). Also $1M to Lindsey Graham's Security is Strength in 2025, NRSC/NRCC max-outs in Jun 2024. No itemized gift to Trump's campaign committee. Not CBS News and not Oracle PAC.

David Ellison's 2024 window leans the other way from Larry: $929,600 to Harris Victory Fund (27 Feb 2024), plus DNC hard-money max-outs and $10k gifts to state Democratic parties the same day. CNN and CNBC reported the victory-fund figure. Different checkbook from Larry and from CBS News. The WBD deal is still paused — this is not CNN money.
